name: Albano Laziale (Italy)
description: Vertical bicolour of maroon (purple in the blazon) and orange-yellow.
history: Municipal flag of Albano Laziale, a comune in Lazio; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office. The arms and gonfalone were granted by decree of the President of the Republic on 24 November 2008.
